performance_issues.description: RemoveOrgUser iterates over all user's repos calling WatchRepo per repo, then iterates over all teams calling removeTeamMember per team. Each removeTeamMember itself iterates over team repos calling RecalculateUserAccess per repo.
performance_issues.impact: For a user in N teams with M total repos, this generates O(N*M) queries within a single transaction
performance_issues.code_snippet: for _, repoID := range repoIDs { repo, err := repo_model.GetRepositoryByID(ctx, repoID) ... }
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch repo loading and batch access recalculation instead of per-repo loops

performance_issues.description: The entire member removal (including all team removals and access recalculations) runs in a single long-running database transaction
performance_issues.impact: For orgs with many repos/teams, this transaction can hold locks for extended periods
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider breaking into smaller transactions or using async processing for access cleanup

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch load repos instead of per-ID GetRepositoryByID calls in the unwatch loop
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce N repo queries to 1 batch query
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use repo_model.GetRepositoriesByIDs(ctx, repoIDs) instead of per-ID loading

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch delete access records and unwatch in single queries instead of per-repo operations
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce 2N queries to 2 queries for repos
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Already partially done for access (bulk delete with IN clause), but WatchRepo is still per-repo
